title: Partial Results on Erdos Problem 708

proof_provenance.scope_note: Internally audited working proofs for explicitly restricted classes; not external human peer review.

main_results.status: proved within stated sufficient hypotheses in the working note
main_results.scope: Source-specific integer floor/ceiling criterion or rational cofactor-support criterion implies an exact cover of at most 2n distinct positions for every shift x>=0.

main_results.status: proved restricted asymptotic-in-M theorem in the working note
main_results.scope: For each fixed alpha>1/(2e), exact 2n holds for sufficiently large M if every source prime factor is at least M^alpha.

main_results.status: proved restricted class using a cited long-interval input
main_results.scope: For fixed delta>0 and cofactor support Q with sum(1/q)<=1-delta, tau<=2n+o_delta(n) uniformly in this class.

main_results.status: proved restricted source classes in the working note
main_results.scope: An arbitrary fixed finite small-prime set E can be absorbed under the exact condition (4.7) when every source also has a prime factor in R; allowing E-only sources yields the stated restricted asymptotic conclusion.

main_results.status: proved under ordered support conditions in the working note
main_results.scope: Bounded-profile level comparison and raw H2 under sum_{p in P}1/p+rho_y(P)<=1; the note also states the profile-dependent ordered criterion.

main_results.status: proved under the explicit conditions in the working note
main_results.scope: One arbitrary added prime after level dominance; separately, at most two smaller anchors with H_R+(2^|E|/theta_E)rho_y(R)<=1.

main_results.status: proved fixed-support theorem in the working note
main_results.scope: For each fixed finite P, H2 eventually holds uniformly in shifts and weights in [0,1]. The threshold depends on P, not merely its cardinality.

main_results.status: proved fixed-support corollary in the working note; independently internally audited
main_results.scope: For each fixed nonempty finite prime set P, with k=|P|, M>=M0(P), and n distinct P-smooth sources in [2,M], every shift x>=0 admits an integer product cover of at most 2n+k-1 distinct positions.
main_results.fixed_support_asymptotic_upper_bound: (2+o(1))n, uniformly in every shift x>=0 for each fixed P

main_results.status: proved finite reduction, not an unrestricted verification
main_results.scope: For fixed M and finite P, at most 2M relevant valuation patterns per prime suffice for the target-hinge minimization; CRT realizes their joint choices on actual consecutive intervals.

main_results.status: equivalence recorded using the cited raw fractional transfer; missing uniform bound not established
main_results.scope: For every epsilon>0, a bound Delta_{2+epsilon}<=C_epsilon uniform in M,x,w would settle the unrestricted asymptotic problem.
